entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: An ogre slavemaster who commands a small army of warrior-slaves and demands tribute from anyone climbing the cliffs of Murasa.

entities.name: Kazuul's warrior-slaves
entities.description: The chained ogre brutes and other slaves of Kazuul, who attack expeditions that refuse to pay his tribute.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar ringed by terrible cliffs and treacherous currents, said to hold hidden treasures and wild mana.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane of varied environments focused on land and exploration.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker and vampire who lives long by feeding on the lifeblood of other creatures.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: A black-aligned planeswalker who gained eternal youth and power through a contract with demons.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An old planeswalker with a vast arsenal of spellcraft who has been worse for wear since the Mending.

entities.name: the Mending
entities.description: The event that made planeswalkers mortal.

events.summary: Travelers who try to sail around Murasa are drawn in and wreck their ships against its cliffs.
events.quote: It's impossible to sail past Zendikar's continent of Murasa.

events.summary: Kazuul demands a tribute from anyone attempting to climb Murasa's cliffs, and sets his slaves on those who refuse.
events.quote: All he asks—all he asks!—is a tribute.

events.summary: The Mending is recalled as having made planeswalkers mortal.
events.quote: although he's been much the worse for wear since the Mending made planeswalkers mortal

relations.quote: He commands a small army of warrior-slaves.

relations.note: Both are black planeswalkers cited as extending their lives.
relations.quote: Liliana, for her part, took a daring but straightforward route to eternal youth and power: a contract with demons.

relations.note: Murasa is a continent of Zendikar.
relations.quote: It's impossible to sail past Zendikar's continent of Murasa.
